verdict.rationale: Wise's API documents batch groups: a named collection of up to 1000 transfers that can be managed as a single unit. It also documents bulk settlement of multiple transfers in one bank transfer, funding batches from the multi-currency account, and direct-debit accounts used to fund batch transfers. Together these clearly deliver bulk operations for payments. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations beyond transfers (e.g. cards, recipients), in-depth docs on batch lifecycle and error handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
